challenges.strawMan: Security testing is only truly relevant in the Testing phase. Doing it earlier just slows down the developers and creates 'Analysis Paralysis' for the business.

options.text: Correct. We should prioritize speed and only fix security bugs once the code is fully functional.
Wrong. 'Shifting Left' identifies flaws in the Design phase when they cost 10x less to fix than in production.
Correct. We should remove all development environments and only code on air-gapped machines to be safe.

challenges.strawMan: We have a professional security guard at the front gate, so we don't need to waste budget on badge readers for the internal server room doors.

options.text: Defense in Depth requires layered controls; a guard is only the first perimeter and can be bypassed or social-engineered.
Guards are 100% effective as long as they have a clear line of sight to the servers.
We should replace all guards with automated turrets to ensure zero human error.
